text:
lia: quick triage - proposing MVP observability bundle: 3 dashboard cards, lightweight trace sampling for hot routes, cost delta alerts, simple error clusters. target: 5 weeks.

omar: sounds good. define 'lightweight' sampling?

lia: baseline 0.5% at edge, tail-sample 100% when latency > 250ms or status >= 500. keep traces minimal (span ids + timings + stack-hash). no payloads.

felix: dashboard cards?

lia: 1) overview: QPS, p50/p95, cost/day. 2) cost breakdown: route, region. 3) errors: top error classes + trend. traces panel shows sampled recent traces for marked hot routes.

haru: cost freshness? 10m acceptable?

omar: yes 10m. pre-aggregate on ingest to avoid heavy joins.

lia: launch criteria: dashboards render in staging + sandbox + 1 pilot customer; tail traces visible; cost overhead <5%; alerts for cost spike and error spike tested; docs + quickstart ready.

felix: acceptance tests: traffic replay 3x, inject errors, cost delta simulation, verify alerts and sample traces.

omar: risks: sampling misconfig, trace volume spikes, UI timeouts when drilling down. mitigations: per-tenant caps, rate-limit ingestion, cap trace UI to 40 samples.

haru: owners: omar (sampling ingestion), felix (cost rollups), lia (product + pilots), haru (alerts + grouping).

ops-bot: Deployment scheduled: staging/observe-mvp @ 2024-06-18T08:00:00Z

lia: timeline suggestion: wk1 sampling + caps, wk2 cost rollups, wk3 UI cards, wk4 pilot, wk5 polish + launch window.

felix: must-cuts if behind: remove model rollup; limit traces to errors-only; reduce retention to 24h.

omar: config snippet for visibility: 
```
sampling:
  baseline: 0.005
  tail_threshold_ms: 250
  error_sample_rate: 1.0
  per_tenant_cap: 300000
```

lia: please ack owners by EOD Thu, i'll consolidate into a trimmed spec. thanks :rocket:
